facts.fact: BCX announced in February 2014 that its two Midrand data centres, NDC1 and NDC2 (New Road Data Centre 2), are both Uptime Institute Tier IV certified; the article says BCX sells managed hosting and colocation from them.
BCX's NDC1 and NDC2 data centres in Midrand are operating and sell managed hosting space and racks for customer colocation (Hypertext, 2014-09-09).
